### 

### **新智元报道**

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=9821b506&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYWGxcbmnyYvqrSqhntcbPdelKBG0JLug4pEX8icjBSe5eib6PekswOSvrq8ybatQJRDr9Vib5WOKaUuibKfLb5qH3J4kEIYmC4NQJU%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

藏不住了，这次是彻底藏不住了！

**Google DeepMind、Figure、1X、Genesis AI、Dyna Robotics……**

硅谷这一轮最火的机器人玩家，背后竟站着同一家数据「供血商」。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=14da80d8&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYX6wW6GeOK0eNscbjBU20PiadDfIBESbAQvIAxTQIUSBiaDib5pHerRVqfI22ZFsCUqziaanW6c48XataC8Sm4lWvowDVyaPOiboS1w%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

Dyna-2跑出100万小时的Scaling Law，背后有它。

GENE-26.5一口气完成一顿20步的饭，用到的第一人称数据，也来自这里。

能拿下这些头部客户，光会「数据采集」显然不够。

这家神秘公司手里，还有另一张更硬核的王牌——强大的数据处理与算法能力。

那些行业中最难啃的corner cases，手被挡住、戴着透明手套、动作快到发虚的画面，到了他们的手里，依然能一帧一帧重新提取成模型可学的材料。

也正因为采集、处理、算法、交付整条链路全部打通，**它才能沉淀出150万小时高质量数据存量，并在全球累计完成200万小时级别的数据交付。**

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=d2519d0a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_gif%2FRvq8Ow69CYV2SoviahlJdAMzWaULT3WH7zEn2dEBg1suEhZ3HR6jVYGianSGKFMnmLibD3V2S9Z4sZFvic6Am5l7aNVj4icjtQqlcrA60iccbpHzo%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

快速移动+多手入镜，依旧可以稳定识别

能做到这个量级，基本上已经算是头部机器人公司背后的数据基础设施了。

如今，这家神秘公司终于揭晓了——它，就是Maxinsights！

一家扎根硅谷的Physical AI团队，头部客户几乎都在美国，今年3月才悄悄回到国内开展业务。

它要做的，是把真实世界的人类经验，规模化变成Physical AI的训练燃料。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=6568e90c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FUicQ7HgWiaUb3uEdSPKrwGNmZEOaaGyzVvZ8dTtE9jU1rFsda3llYbCZpmWfiazUYjWBLTGvlPpXucH8Q0lEUJN3Q%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

**人类日常视频**

**成为Physical AI恶补的大课**

那么问题来了，一家做数据的公司，为什么要训自己的模型？又为什么要把模型做到如此高精？

答案，要从Physical AI走进现实世界的那道门槛说起。

让Physical AI解释怎么叠衣服，和让它真的把衣服叠好，中间隔着大量细节。

手应该抓在哪里？衣角被压住了怎么办？布料滑动之后，下一步动作该怎么调整？

这些经验，很少被完整写进文字。人类却每天都在使用它们。

大语言模型能跑通Scaling Law，是因为互联网早就替它攒好了文本；视觉模型也继承了几十亿张现成的图片。

机器人从来没有这样的条件。互联网上有几十亿小时的视频，却几乎没有一段是从「手的视角」记录人怎么干活的。

而第一人称数据，也叫Egocentric Data或Ego数据，提供了一种记录方式——

从操作者的视角，拍下双手如何与物体交互，以及动作发生前后，环境出现了什么变化。

它让学习材料，更贴近任务本身。

过去教机器人干活，主流做法是遥操作。也就是，一个人戴着设备远程控制机器人抓杯子、叠毛巾，机器人把每一次动作记下来。

这种数据质量高，但贵、慢，一台机器人一天也就产出几小时，而且数据和特定的机器人本体绑死，换一台机器就得重采。

第一人称数据的价值，就在这里。

采集设备跟随操作者，记录他看到的场景，以及双手与物体的交互过程。

人在厨房、工作台和生活空间里积累的操作经验，由此有了进入训练系统的机会。

然而，拍下来，只是第一步。

**![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=0356db0c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FUicQ7HgWiaUb351381bTy5MO2IN89mV41M88GEiaCCibDxJoaQjYV6HfRtafnmEmfM3R1p0tmkHgBOVuXBD6UJKpsQ%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)**

**视频不等于训练数据**

以人类在厨房拧瓶盖的视频举例，人看一眼，就知道发生了什么。

进入训练流程后，却需要进一步拆解——

哪只手握住瓶身，哪只手开始旋转，动作从哪一帧开始、在哪一帧结束，手腕在空间中如何移动。

如果两只手交叉，手指被瓶身挡住，或者动作太快带来模糊，判断就会变难。

一句「正在拧瓶盖」的标签，解释不了这些细节。

机器人要的是带着结构的数据，而非一段影像。

Maxinsights的算法到底强在哪里？团队介绍的一段演示，把三层能力放到了同一条数据里。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=6568e90c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FUicQ7HgWiaUb3uEdSPKrwGNmZEOaaGyzVvZ8dTtE9jU1rFsda3llYbCZpmWfiazUYjWBLTGvlPpXucH8Q0lEUJN3Q%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

**这张王牌算法，解决了什么**

**先来看人，手被挡住了，动作还能不能追得上？**

人在真实环境中干活，上半身一直在动，双手还会交叉、被物体遮挡。追踪系统要从不断变化的画面里，尽可能准确地还原身体与手部姿态。

但视频的演示中，即便在这样的情况下，算法追踪仍能保持较高准确性。

这背后，自研MaxEgo所承担的手部与姿态信息提取，正是这套处理能力的重要组成部分。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=cbca1d43&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_gif%2FRvq8Ow69CYXMsY9M5IvHeNRUrxXpicQ97ODz8Uibgzma7rTREo7UhFBx0jpr7zBxOicPl2WtlVpLibvW1kw4nxF9G6gOfJAvmRjgP9SfSjvMXSI%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

遮挡的手部追踪依然稳定

难就难在，真实操作不会为了方便算法，始终把双手摆在镜头前。

抓取时手指被物体挡住，转身时视角发生变化，这些片段都包含有价值的动作信息。追踪越可靠，后续训练就越有机会保留这些细节。

**再来看空间，人出门走了一圈，****系统还能不能对回原点****？**

这里考验的是SLAM，也就是一边确定自身位置，一边建立周围环境的地图。

拍摄者不断移动时，定位误差可能逐渐累积。人明明回到了出发点，系统记录的轨迹却未必能对得上。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=91016be9&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_gif%2FRvq8Ow69CYXTtzDIy04LATh1tLsJQ0iazzG5On2wicPPTFQogPRs9rVP2J8J9LX277HXtrNWNib8r8B2EoOic1bVBflXVKVicBA2IgUrTEQyLX8o%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

这段演示里，从出门到绕一圈回来，轨迹能够较好地闭合，与起点重新对齐。

由此一来，这让手部动作有了更完整的空间背景——

手怎样运动、人在什么位置，以及周围环境的几何关系，可以被放在一起理解。

这背后全靠团队打底的硬功夫。

Maxinsights的核心工程班底集结了Waymo、谷歌、Meta、QCraft等等顶尖企业，以及斯坦福、伯克利前沿实验室的资深人才，大多深耕自动驾驶多年。

作为一个由海量数据驱动的行业，团队早已具备了管理与迭代百万级车端数据的成熟实战经验。

如今转向机器人，底层的工程方法与数据链路依旧纯熟。

**最后再来看动作，轨迹追到了，还要讲清楚人在做什么。**

在演示中，语言标注由自研视频理解与标注模型生成，能够较准确地对应实际操作。

在Maxinsights的数据体系里，这些信息会按照环境、任务、子任务、动作指令分层组织。

比如，一段酒店房间里的操作，可以拆成：

酒店房间 → 打扫房间 → 摆放水壶 → 双手把水壶放到桌上。

这就把运动轨迹与任务含义联系起来：模型既能获得身体和双手如何运动的信息，也能知道这些动作是在完成什么目标。

身体怎么动、在空间里怎么走、正在做什么，三层信息合在一起，一段日常视频才有了更完整的学习价值。

数据处理得越深入，原始画面中可供模型学习的信息就越丰富。

根据内部版本的评测，从MaxEgo 0.5到1.0，相关难例上的关键误差指标下降超过一半。

支撑算法迭代的，是20亿余帧人体姿态数据，以及人工校正和高精度参考数据构成的验证体系。

这也解释了，为什么数据积累和算法能力会相互促进。

在姿态追踪、空间定位与动作理解之外，还有更深的物理信息可挖。

按Maxinsights的排序，往上还有身体与环境几何、物体位姿，以及最难测、也最值钱的接触信息。

因此，在Maxinsights的流程里，采集之后还连接着质量检查、格式统一、视频理解、空间处理、姿态追踪和人工校正，交付前再进行检查与格式转换。

两个模型加上四阶段自动化QA，把98%的质检覆盖交给机器完成，人只处理机器拿不准的那部分。

而人纠正过的样本，又回流成下一版模型的训练数据。

这是一个越做越顺的飞轮：交付得越多，模型越准，标注越便宜。

**![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=0356db0c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FUicQ7HgWiaUb351381bTy5MO2IN89mV41M88GEiaCCibDxJoaQjYV6HfRtafnmEmfM3R1p0tmkHgBOVuXBD6UJKpsQ%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)**

**5000个人的手艺，第一次被「电子化」**

技术之外，Maxinsights更难复制的是另一件事——

怎么让全球5000+名采集员，持续、不重样地拍出真实生活。

**Maxinsights****在多个国家铺了直管的现场团队加****社区****网络，覆盖2000+采集环境、50000+场景，月采集产能45万小时。**

运营靠一个Agent平台调度：

* 它会盯着数据分布，发现「餐厅后厨够多了、修车间不够」，就把设备和人往缺口调；
* 它会识别无效片段、摆拍片段、佩戴偏移；
* 它还会让场景每两周轮换一次，避免同一个厨房被拍到模型厌倦。

采集员是谁？

很多是家庭主妇，餐馆厨师，车间工人，农场采摘不同水果的农民，维修各种汽车的工程师，照顾老人的陪护等等......

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=160178a0&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_gif%2FRvq8Ow69CYWblIWcicSGRgDVqHtepIfyBPrmOJDzQ545rI1JeHCn4w1yokSQtFeExdtq9HWjNicuyqXVK0QwoJgLBqulKwSPPcgEqPqTFp35E%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=9ca3ebc4&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_gif%2FRvq8Ow69CYXQUPoelVhzgGOHGd0h6KQniaI9HNLPibE4lBxicut64CRHYIBFZIFlm5ib8ueGPZfc3rNic7OurfhNOkyIJlD2d16iabRZSiac5WNC0I%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

一位主妇几十年切菜、择菜、拧瓶盖的手感，过去只存在于她自己的肌肉记忆里。

现在，她戴着相机做一顿饭，这些动作被拆成手部轨迹、动作时序和语义标签，成了机器人学做家务的第一课。

这大概是普通人第一次，能把「手艺」直接卖给Physical AI。

对模型公司来说，这也是最不可替代的一部分——

真实生活里的凌乱、失误和临场调整，实验室里怎么演都演不出来。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=6568e90c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FUicQ7HgWiaUb3uEdSPKrwGNmZEOaaGyzVvZ8dTtE9jU1rFsda3llYbCZpmWfiazUYjWBLTGvlPpXucH8Q0lEUJN3Q%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

**百万小时，进入模型训练**

**今年夏天最火的两个机器人，便是由Maxinsights的数据「喂」大的。**

8月10日，Dyna Robotics发布Dyna-2，拿100万小时人类第一人称视频做预训练。

这相当于一个人睁着眼睛过了170年。

从1000小时到100万小时，模型性能跨越四个数量级持续单调提升，暂时看不到天花板。而且用更多人类数据预训练的模型，在从未见过的机器人数据上表现同样更好。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=c765208f&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYWdrfd7hyUBtOBbpKKXnGPaVqtLdjBtWNyRMQkbG5MKKRVpicibfZ5zLwGItqwicl6psmx57Zc1j82ib7gYewac6MrtMEv7rCCicHnw%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=2a37af88&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYVsicG2ZscWdkRlneUBxWrro4PxYfPLBFACUQnfrJCkn9RGd2hVvhXoqldoG1zoU2qLDoGVfaWutLFxqRia7hKTzs4QYnR8Ynr4w%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

这100万小时，最大的供应商就是Maxinsights。

再往前5月，Genesis AI发布GENE-26.5，机器人两只手做完一顿20步的饭：切菜、打蛋、倒果昔，中间不用人接手。

GENE-26.5的第一人称数据合作伙伴，还是Maxinsights。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=b0546b1c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_gif%2FRvq8Ow69CYWqPiaTkRiav7foZXdJBRTicWF4DCujzx3dO1U2taJPPicous4SZCcFib7C9wOaibbeRAz6ibynMCamuyJhibmfpFFht5KUYTnUQOEv6rk%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

Genesis把第一人称视频和带传感器的手套数据叠在一起用，结果是许多高难度技能只靠不到一小时的机器人专属数据，就能达到自主执行。

硅谷这一轮出圈的两个具身智能模型，背后都有这家美国公司的数据支持。

**对Maxinsights而言，美国头部客户一直是业务重心。从样本评估到大批量交付，它积累的，是与当地前沿团队持续配合、跟着训练需求一起扩量的经验。**

Maxinsights的「家底」同样硬核——

2024年起步，从机器人遥操作数据采集切入，跟着湾区头部基础模型和机器人团队一路做到今天。累计交付超200万小时第一人称数据，仓库里压着150万小时以上带手部追踪和语言标注。

每月采集能力45万小时，Dyna-2那100万小时的训练量，两个多月就能采一遍。

**好像大家满世界寻找的海量精品 EGO 数据，绕了一圈才发现——原来就在Maxinsights手里。**

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=e9dd4a46&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_gif%2FRvq8Ow69CYUB5iaacjGvSiceqiaA4dyiajY2nUTVlPqsUWYAXVC3IuQ3lj06iahIoWp86esD1h7DGsW5xeSnOu6m8JD7c5mDF0ZuCbfchIWicSWQM%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=6568e90c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FUicQ7HgWiaUb3uEdSPKrwGNmZEOaaGyzVvZ8dTtE9jU1rFsda3llYbCZpmWfiazUYjWBLTGvlPpXucH8Q0lEUJN3Q%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

**Scaling Law涌现之后**

Dyna-2证明了一件事，机器人领域的Scaling Law存在，而且到100万小时还没看到天花板。

游戏规则从此变了。

具身智能的下半场竞争会变得很朴素：谁能持续、稳定、便宜地把真实世界喂进模型，谁就跑得快。

去年，特斯拉让Optimus团队的采集员戴上头盔、背上背包，五个摄像头对着自己的手，一遍遍叠衬衫。

8月下旬，Figure上线了众包平台Index，普通人打开App自己开抽屉、叠衣服就能拿钱。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=105321be&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYX4tuhJ67rm4Zx7Mkc1JzJHZlhFicv82XiclB4MkSqbiaUvCsnQibM8ALb5mrcTK0HM5zaVdVtlIBMFDI134Iw3pzsKqoZeCAdr16U%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

之所以连特斯拉和Figure都要自己下场拍，是因为这个世界从来没有为机器人准备过一份「人类动作的互联网」。

Physical AI的互联网，得从零开始制造。

而Maxinsights，是目前少数几家在真正动手建造它的公司之一。

「制造」这个词，并不夸张。人需要真正执行任务，传感器需要持续采集，采完之后数据还要经过同步、验证、标注和质检，最后才变成训练系统能直接消费的形式。

Maxinsights把这件事概括成一句话：Physical AI的Scaling Law，同时也是一条Manufacturing Law。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=c008b798&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_gif%2FRvq8Ow69CYXbJ0TR08cWfvXr5jV5jMemNMuuDElich2IZBZsunPJM6YbgNMgByWFR4ib3icLVz6EiaxT3b5JPMfy2ozfEBK4Mw8ySArR7HtEbt8%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

整条管线是一串关口，良率是乘出来的。四道关口各95%，端到端只剩81%；各提到99%，就是96%。到1000万小时的规模，这15个点决定的是顺利交付还是大规模返工。

这也是Maxinsights把硬件、模型、真值体系、全球运营和交付管线放在一起的原因。它的定位是，成为Physical AI的数据与学习基础设施。

交付之外，Maxinsights还看到了下一道考题。

过了100万小时，规模依然重要，但更重要的是每新增一个小时，有没有为模型带来新的物理经验。

他把这叫Experience Density：同样一小时，固定桌面上反复抓取放置，和双手协同、物体状态不断变化、带工具使用的一小时，学习价值天差地别。在1万小时的规模上这只是噪声，到1000万小时，它就是预算本身。

数据规模上去之后，第1000万个小时和已有数据的相似度，会远高于当年第1万个小时。不主动设计，规模就只是重复。

这也是Maxinsights那个Agent平台盯着数据分布往缺口调人的原因。

所以这套体系最终要回答的问题有两个：客户扩大训练需求时，数据能不能跟上；跟上的每一小时，是不是模型没见过的世界。

150万小时，对Maxinsights来说是一个起点。

第一个100万小时，回答的是Scale是否有效。接下来的1000万小时，要回答的是一个小时究竟值多少。

拍下世界只是起点，把它持续变成模型学得会的材料，才是这场工程赛跑的硬功夫。

entries.title: 老黄替OpenAI宣布AGI！出题人当场打脸：换个考场99.9%掉到62.7%
entries.content:
ASI启示录 2026-09-11 13:13 北京

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=4090b169&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2FRvq8Ow69CYVWQpE9ThIiafSlzvRhqxibJZaibZBcEvOCTjN8Bp1LJyBXb2bHRh9BtCcoYJiamicia7BVNbRwMsgoOhiblDPQKRlpiaJGEdWBjtnCEAs%2F0%3Fwx_fmt%3Djpeg)

### 

### **新智元报道**

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=9821b506&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYWGxcbmnyYvqrSqhntcbPdelKBG0JLug4pEX8icjBSe5eib6PekswOSvrq8ybatQJRDr9Vib5WOKaUuibKfLb5qH3J4kEIYmC4NQJU%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

上周四，OpenAI发布GPT-6 Astra。

官网给它的定性是「世界上最智能、最对齐的模型」。

紧接着，黄仁勋在X上发了一条帖子，把这件事推向另一个高度：

AGI已经到来。恭喜OpenAI团队。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=284a2f8a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYXOHP5F7ptdcMdbsmIiaybiceORBlR3ucES7Aib7k9qNN9rN4yFx2PoRNKozxWlw3YH6SMcT3AicOUMWvbyIGExWNEkHZDIsRspxkA%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

反观GPT-6 Astra的官方发布页，通篇找不到「AGI已实现」这样的字眼。

一个卖GPU的，替做模型的，把话说满了。

更有意思的，是出题的人。

OpenAI发布页写着Astra在ARC-AGI-3上拿到99.9%，「饱和」了这个以AGI命名的基准。

负责出卷子的评测机构ARC Prize看完跑分，却一把拒签：「不算。」

ARC Prize基金会当天就发文拆解：

这个分数来自OpenAI定制的测试环境，换成对所有厂商一视同仁的标准环境，只有62.7%。

他们的结论只有一句：Astra在泛化上有实质进展，「但我们不宣称它是AGI」。

芯片供应商直接盖章，模型厂商留了余地，负责出题的基准机构直接拒签。

这大概是过去几天AI圈最魔幻的一幕：AGI这次没有被真正「实现」，而是被各方代言人在社交平台上「宣布」了。

## OpenAI自己怎么说？

在发布当天的记者电话会上，总裁Greg Brockman说了一句极具煽动性的话：

欢迎来到AGI时代。

他甚至预言，如果几年后回头看AGI是何时诞生的，「大概就是这个时期，可能就是这个模型。」

听起来像官宣？

但他立刻又补了两个限定词：第一，这是他「个人判断」；第二，AGI是个灰色、模糊的概念，「到底算不算，由用户自己决定。」

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=902501c1&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYWRbyxxOJwy9kN39HFtHHCK25oMPu1L4Iib0LlU5KodHsXJgO3OpFZlyKjZu9TVQdjOGTahpmkQh50SicEvDwaAsl4JPaWalFBeM%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

在自家最重要的产品发布会上，总裁居然用「个人看法」来给时代定调，甚至还把最终裁定权甩给了网友。

这只能说明一件事：OpenAI内部，也拿不出一份明确、能公示的AGI认定书。

更有意思的是CEO奥特曼的态度。

在Astra发布前，他曾公开吐槽「AGI」是个定义糟糕、接近营销术语的词。

CEO嫌这个词太虚，总裁拿它当「个人看法」，官网干脆闭口不提。

黄仁勋那句AGI的「盖章」和恭喜，恰好就落在了这个微妙的空白里。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=6568e90c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FUicQ7HgWiaUb3uEdSPKrwGNmZEOaaGyzVvZ8dTtE9jU1rFsda3llYbCZpmWfiazUYjWBLTGvlPpXucH8Q0lEUJN3Q%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

**99.9%与62.7%**

**同一张卷子的两套成绩**

Astra到底强不强？

OpenAI发布页上写着：

Astra在以AGI命名的基准测试ARC-AGI-3上拿到了99.9%的逆天高分，「饱和」了这个测试。

但打脸来得也快。

当天，负责出题的ARC Prize基金会就发文，把这个「99.9%」当众拆解了。

原来Astra考了两次。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=3f0bafb5&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYUogibW7oWK8hsqKzk200iaNem7gzPKA8AVr4Gaib1U6NaHSQab7jOibAjYibBuRoyibiahGeKiaS2axDo32QiaH7nY0iaTApkS9Prp4jazQ%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

ARC-AGI-3榜单，Astra两套环境的成绩分开标注；同榜Claude Opus 5为30.2%，GPT-5.6 Sol为7.8%。

在OpenAI深度定制的「自带工具」环境下（允许模型保留推理状态、用独家技术管理长对话），它确实考了99.9%，花了近1.9万美元。

但如果换成对所有厂商一视同仁的「裸考」标准环境，它的最高分其实只有62.7%，成本更是飙升到2.6万美元。

ARC Prize的态度很坚决：未来的AGI，必须能在标准条件下解题。带工具拿到的99.9%和裸考拿到的62.7%，完全是两码事。

当然出题人也承认Astra带来了「阶跃式」的惊喜，在96%的关卡里，Astra用的动作数比人类还少，平均少用51.7%。

这是AI第一次在动作效率上全面碾压人类。

可ARC Prize早就把话说在前头：ARC-AGI-3上线那天他们就写明，刷满这个基准不等于「证明达到了AGI」。

理由很简单：测试环境再难也是封闭的，机制确定、目标封闭，代表不了真实世界的复杂与开放。

就像一个学霸，卷子考了满分，到了真实职场未必依然能够开挂。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=6568e90c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FUicQ7HgWiaUb3uEdSPKrwGNmZEOaaGyzVvZ8dTtE9jU1rFsda3llYbCZpmWfiazUYjWBLTGvlPpXucH8Q0lEUJN3Q%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

**10万颗炼模型**

**40万颗卖未来**

既然出题人都不认，老黄为什么最急着宣布「AGI已到」？

仔细拆解黄仁勋的那条帖子，你会发现它的信息结构比表面热闹得多。

帖子全文是：

GPT-6 Astra，在约10万颗NVIDIA Grace Blackwell NVLink72上训练。从ChatGPT到o1再到Astra，只用了4年。AGI已经到来。恭喜OpenAI团队。接下来还有40万颗GPU上线。

第一个数字：10万颗。

Astra是OpenAI迄今规模最大的一次训练，用掉了超过10万颗GPU。

第二个数字：4年。

从ChatGPT到o1再到Astra，黄仁勋用一条时间线，把对话模型、推理模型和所谓的AGI连成了一条直线。

第三个数字：40万颗。

「接下来还有40万颗GPU上线。」

这40万颗归谁？什么型号？用来干嘛？黄仁勋在这里留下了悬念。

但当这三个数字与「AGI已到」被塞进同一条帖子里时，读者脑海中就会出现这样一种商业叙事：

10万颗GPU砸出了Astra（也就是AGI），那接下来的40万颗会砸出什么？

在这个语境下，AGI不再是一个抽象的技术终点，而变成了一份最有力的算力需求证明。

一旦AGI被公认「已到」，天价的算力就不再是企业的成本项，而是谁都不敢下牌桌的必需品。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=6568e90c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FUicQ7HgWiaUb3uEdSPKrwGNmZEOaaGyzVvZ8dTtE9jU1rFsda3llYbCZpmWfiazUYjWBLTGvlPpXucH8Q0lEUJN3Q%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

**推特上的AGI**

**进不了商业合同**

去年10月，OpenAI和微软的新协议里写了一条：OpenAI宣布AGI之后，还得由一个独立专家小组核验。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=1df6cba7&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYWZWb5sY1EjxNlIYW9zwxHbm0mjGuMTFccOUyppz9tKm6VS1Y193E1IyicQRQDFB0s7lCKibhqzwoa9qKxtskicU0Z7xOnj6ianMFs%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

今年2月两家又联合重申，合同里AGI的定义和认定流程「均保持不变」。

到了4月，协议再度修订，微软的收入分成改为「与OpenAI技术进展无关」，外界普遍解读为AGI条款对商业利益的触发作用已经大幅弱化。

也就是说，Brockman在记者会上说什么、黄仁勋在X上写什么、ARC-AGI-3跑了多少分，都不构成合同意义上的AGI认定。

眼下正是OpenAI筹备IPO的关键节点，死对头Anthropic也在冲刺上市。

「AGI」这个词早已写进了OpenAI与微软、亚马逊的投资协议里，它牵动的已经超出技术信仰，还有股权定价和商业控制权。

这就能解释，为什么Brockman只敢说是「个人判断」，为什么OpenAI官网严防死守不提AGI。

舆论场上可以尽情欢迎AGI时代，落到合同里，一个字都不能多写。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=6568e90c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FUicQ7HgWiaUb3uEdSPKrwGNmZEOaaGyzVvZ8dTtE9jU1rFsda3llYbCZpmWfiazUYjWBLTGvlPpXucH8Q0lEUJN3Q%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

**谁有资格宣布AGI？**

Bloomberg一篇长文把这个问题捋了一遍，答案是没人说了算。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=d5f859bf&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYUDMoiaEYAwLvoFtjeK5ooa7eSSp1k21wanDcibcAj0kygiclD9BDeEic981Sic3fOHtVV2cPyg8aTkOibhFKnsoibeM8mKhPJIibYSjkg%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

先看定义。

OpenAI的版本是「在大多数具有经济价值的任务上超越人类的系统」。

谷歌DeepMind 2023年的论文不看经济价值，看通用性，看能不能用很少的数据学会新技能。

ARC Prize更直接，说经济价值「是衡量智能的错误尺度」，他们的定义是「能高效习得训练数据之外新技能的系统」。

连词也都不一样。

Anthropic的Dario Amodei不爱说AGI，改叫「强大人工智能」（powerful AI）。微软的Mustafa Suleyman造了个「可用人工智能」（artificial capable intelligence）。

Meta和OpenAI最近干脆跳过AGI，直接谈「超级智能」（superintelligence）。

时间表更乱。

2024年9月，奥特曼说「指向AGI的系统正在显现」，甚至说「几千天内」可能有超级智能。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=f3c00b36&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYUsvwDdNkM1vib8SriawtThiaJlcAU1GtichJSQoF7sCWg9icfJmyYdxibtwgr1oOywzd9BETUwqX1NZApN6CL7hiau0q6LDiahibXvg42w%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

一年后GPT-5发布，他承认「我们还缺一样相当重要的东西」，但没说缺什么。

再一年，Brockman在Astra发布会上说「欢迎来到AGI时代」。

DeepMind那边，Shane Legg从1999年起就押2028年前实现AGI的概率是50%；Demis Hassabis却说还要五到十年，时间线看起来在缩短，只是因为「AGI的定义正在被稀释」。

于是就出了眼下这个局面。

同一个词，四拨人用四种方式定义它。

模型公司握着产品叙事，只晒跑分不下定论；

芯片巨头握着算力叙事，急着宣布时代降临；

基准机构握着测试标尺，死死咬住底线，不承认；

微软这样的大金主握着合同条款，稳坐钓鱼台，按规则算账。

过去四年，全行业争的是谁最先做出AGI。

最近，叙事时态变了，从「还要一到三年」「最快半年」，直接跳到「已经到来」。

可一套公认的AGI验收标准，至今没人拿得出来。

参考资料：

<https://x.com/JensenHuang/status/2096700264569090384>

<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/features/2026-09-04/what-is-agi-openai-anthropic-race-for-artificial-general-intelligence>

<https://www.axios.com/2026/09/03/openai-astra-gpt-6-agi-brockman>

entries.title: 第一篇AI4AI综述：让AI改进AI，发展到哪步了？
entries.content:
新智元 2026-09-11 13:13 北京

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=0523eb8b&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2FRvq8Ow69CYXQ8WYWwd5LE0pyica67CyRItOgdLE5qtSDXic6xVr6lAQ9e4FjvHLJCiaNM1V2ZCswPWbHhvrQqhgty7W7h2FCAa6M3vVNXn3vyc%2F0%3Fwx_fmt%3Djpeg)

### 

### **新智元报道**

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=9821b506&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYWGxcbmnyYvqrSqhntcbPdelKBG0JLug4pEX8icjBSe5eib6PekswOSvrq8ybatQJRDr9Vib5WOKaUuibKfLb5qH3J4kEIYmC4NQJU%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

从long horizon智能体到recursive self-improvement：从「AI 能做什么」出发，进一步追问「Can AI improve AI?」——AI能否可靠地改进AI，并让进步持续积累？

让AI写一段代码，已经是许多人熟悉的工作方式。如果把任务换成「帮我做出一个更好的AI」，它能完成吗？

这意味着AI要提出方案、修改代码、运行实验、判断结果，再把有效的改进留下来。最诱人的前景是：这一轮变强的系统，还能帮助下一轮做得更好。

围绕这个问题，第一篇AI4AI综述论文梳理了数百项研究，将long horizon智能体、AI4AI和recursive self-improvement放进同一张研究地图。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=39759985&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYV7zpgTyDJ3mSMjibrJyvhGxsJIO3QEibd6x43hJAcmVaOdsvoP4AnbrrvwzmvQYOJSdSyftjyeckamhib210rLibbXgM9wyuobdfE%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

论文链接：<https://www.preprints.org/manuscript/202608.2108>

**资源主页（GitHub Pages）：**<https://kaiwu5.github.io/Awesome-AI4AI/>

**项目介绍 / Blog：**<https://simpleagentlab.com/ai4ai>

**Harness（RSIHub）：**<https://github.com/simple-agent-lab/RSIHub>

**这篇综述的主要发现是：****AI****已能在明确的目标和评价规则下承担不少研发工作，但单项能力的提升，还不能保证完整研发流程可靠，更不能证明系统能够持续自我改进。**

这道「会做某一步」与「能把整件事做成」之间的缺口，被论文概括为**composition gap（组合鸿沟）**。对于希望用AI加速研发的人来说，找出这道缺口在哪里，才能判断下一步应该改进模型、工具、记忆，还是检验结果的方式。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=430c5303&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYXpytCibXnPGsNXYcibIVCrQtfdvY9CRyCXT4mJZbUprpCme6xr4DIaU8ibF9GXkDPRQMVfM1BkUDsu6Ur2HNcvPs0mA4o1Re1yYg%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

图 1｜从「会用工具」到「完成AI研发」，中间还需要哪些能力？论文把评测任务、任务难度、模型和运行框架放在一起考察。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=6568e90c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FUicQ7HgWiaUb3uEdSPKrwGNmZEOaaGyzVvZ8dTtE9jU1rFsda3llYbCZpmWfiazUYjWBLTGvlPpXucH8Q0lEUJN3Q%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

**为什么开始讨论AI改进AI**

AI4AI是AI for AI的缩写，可以理解为「用AI帮助研发更好的 AI」。它能改进的对象很多：训练数据、模型本身、运行工具、评测方法，甚至研发流程。

如果这件事能够可靠地完成，研究人员就有机会把一部分精力从重复的实现、试验和排错中释放出来，更快地检验新想法。问题也随之出现：AI完成了工作，是否就意味着它作出了正确的研究判断？

以优化训练流程为例，AI可以修改数据处理代码，再启动训练。但指标涨了，可能来自有效的改进，也可能来自比较条件改变，或者模型过度适应了某套测试。**看起来「做完了」，距离证明「变好了」，还隔着验证。**

综述因此区分了几个常被放在一起的概念。AI 优化一个独立模型，属于 AI4AI；当它修改的是自身组件，才涉及自我改进。进一步走向 recursive self-improvement（递归式地改进自身），还需要让「构建下一代系统的过程」本身可以被改进，并检验收益能否传递到后续版本。

这些概念帮助我们分清：系统到底改了什么，以及结果究竟证明了什么。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=6568e90c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FUicQ7HgWiaUb3uEdSPKrwGNmZEOaaGyzVvZ8dTtE9jU1rFsda3llYbCZpmWfiazUYjWBLTGvlPpXucH8Q0lEUJN3Q%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

**这篇综述如何梳理研究**

论文将分散在智能体、自动化AI研发和自我改进等方向的研究连接起来，同时考察两类测试：一类单独检查检索、编程、工具调用等能力；另一类要求系统完成工程、优化、论文复现等完整研发任务。

阅读每项工作时，综述追问五件事：改进对象是什么，是否改到自己，谁控制目标与各个环节，凭什么判断成功，以及改进能否被保留和迁移。

由此，三个容易混淆的问题被分开：**任务有多难、****AI****有多少决定权、改进证据有多充分。** 运行时间长，不一定代表任务难；自动执行了所有步骤，也不一定代表目标和判断标准由AI决定。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=cd255b20&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYXcnZjxdQOOtBTIo1MUiaHzsuy3TynvCtD04wAxP1qJhPXCHRXiakBpKflk7XCxtH2gVZKfhrL58H2gm8eYUmVcWo1IToA1Rykibc%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

图 2｜一次AI改进要经历计划、执行、反馈和修复。评估时还需分别判断：改了谁，谁作决定，为什么可以相信结果。

**![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=0356db0c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FUicQ7HgWiaUb351381bTy5MO2IN89mV41M88GEiaCCibDxJoaQjYV6HfRtafnmEmfM3R1p0tmkHgBOVuXBD6UJKpsQ%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)**

**发现一：每一步都能做，连起来仍可能失败**

一次AI研发，可能从查资料开始，经过提出假设、修改代码、运行实验，最后形成结论。这些步骤需要共享同一个目标，也需要使用彼此产生的证据。

麻烦往往出在交接处。比如，代码已经更新，分析时却用了上一轮的日志；实验指标看似提高，报告中的对照组却采用了另一套配置。单看每项操作，都像是在推进工作；把它们连起来，结论却可能失去依据。

这就是composition gap的重要含义：检索、编程和工具调用的单项成绩，不能直接当作完整研发能力的证明。

综述强调，long horizon的关键在于前一步会影响后一步。一个早期选择可能改变后续能够采取的行动，一个错误可能直到训练结束后才暴露。系统需要记住关键状态，理解反馈来自哪次尝试，再据此修正计划。

因此，只看运行了多久、调用了多少次工具，还不足以判断能力。更有价值的问题是：**它能否在步骤相互依赖、结果延迟出现时，仍然把目标、版本和证据保持一致？**

对于开发者，如果单项测试过关，完整流程仍然失败，就值得检查最早在哪一次交接中丢失了关键信息，而不只是继续提高单项分数。

**![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=0356db0c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FUicQ7HgWiaUb351381bTy5MO2IN89mV41M88GEiaCCibDxJoaQjYV6HfRtafnmEmfM3R1p0tmkHgBOVuXBD6UJKpsQ%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)**

**发现二：会执行，不等于掌握整个研究过程**

综述观察到，AI 正承担更多规划、编程、实验和修复工作，但人类通常仍在决定研究目标、评价标准，以及什么结果可以被接受。

这一区别很重要。让系统按既定规则优化某个指标，与让它独立判断哪个问题值得研究、什么证据足以支持结论，需要的能力并不相同。

要让AI承担更完整的流程，论文从两侧梳理改进方向。一侧是模型：学会规划、正确使用工具，并从较长的行动过程与反馈中学习。另一侧是**Harness**，即组织智能体运行的工具、记忆、执行和检查机制。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=67cd15bc&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYW86mAJa4cfH8fGoFD9jGTZIkphV1sSlEHdopsoOHGmIytTBu7F9eykNvu9QLoXpytFLnrHwpsylpm3ARVnDrn40HnxAAibnu0E%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

图 3｜模型侧的改进路径。让系统学会做计划，把计划落实为行动，再利用反馈改善后续策略。

Harness 可以理解为研发现场的配套设施：保存实验记录，核对执行结果，遇到问题时恢复，判断何时停止或请人处理。模型和这些机制一起工作，才有机会让一次研发从开头可靠地走到结尾。

这也影响我们如何阅读评测成绩。同一个模型，换一套工具、增加重试次数或允许更多人工帮助，结果都可能变化。比较时应说明预算、工具、评估方式和人工介入条件，才能知道提升来自哪里。

**![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=0356db0c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FUicQ7HgWiaUb351381bTy5MO2IN89mV41M88GEiaCCibDxJoaQjYV6HfRtafnmEmfM3R1p0tmkHgBOVuXBD6UJKpsQ%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)**

**发现三：一次涨分，距离持续变强还有多远**

当一个系统报告「改进成功」，最直观的证据是指标提高了。但综述认为，至少还要分开看四件事。

* **真的提高了吗？** Measured Gain：在声明的指标上，是否测到了实际增益？
* **提高能保住吗？** Retention：继续迭代之后，收益是否仍然存在？
* **与人类相比如何？** Human Comparison：在相近时间和计算预算下，表现怎么样？
* **换个任务还有效吗？** Held-out Transfer：离开优化时使用的任务、模型或领域，收益是否仍然成立？

这四类证据不能相互替代。一套系统可以在某个测试上提高，却没有证明它能够保留收益或迁移到新任务。研究没有报告某项结果，也不能直接理解为已经测试失败。

为什么多做几轮不一定越来越好？因为系统可能忘记早期约束，逐渐偏离目标；也可能越来越善于迎合评分方式，却没有解决真实问题。某个版本一度表现最好，后续修改也可能把收益丢掉。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=be0da136&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FRvq8Ow69CYUHGkYY5DwrZdB2BcjqzhypZwqnVPlzR0EBNxvUGhcfcF2307SfiaofT0iaoWDMLKsMATGCrhdia79m12xO1rvOL0DemQg7kdc3lI%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

图4｜错误会在不同阶段累积：一次尝试中的操作失误、多次尝试间的状态丢失，以及后续版本的退化。结果是否可信、收益来自哪里，也需要贯穿全程的检查。

因此，要支持更强的 recursive self-improvement 主张，需要跟踪后续版本，在明确且可比较的条件下持续验证，确认改进被保留，并确实帮助下一代继续进步。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=6568e90c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FUicQ7HgWiaUb3uEdSPKrwGNmZEOaaGyzVvZ8dTtE9jU1rFsda3llYbCZpmWfiazUYjWBLTGvlPpXucH8Q0lEUJN3Q%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

**未来可以用在哪里**

从综述覆盖的方向看，AI4AI的应用空间包括机器学习工程、训练流程优化、计算效率优化，以及研究工作的复现与验证。它们都包含反复提出方案、执行、检查和修复的过程。

对研究团队而言，一个有价值的方向是让AI接手目标清楚、结果可检验的研发环节，同时保留可追溯的实验记录。这样既能利用自动化，也便于判断哪些工作可靠、哪些仍需人类参与。

对智能体开发团队而言，综述提供了一套定位问题的思路：是模型不会做，信息传递出了错，评价机制不可信，还是有效的改进没有被保留下来？不同原因，需要不同的解决办法。

更远的前景，是让系统不仅完成一次改进，还能把经过验证的经验和收益交给下一代。但按照这篇综述梳理的证据，可靠的研究判断、持久且可迁移的收益，以及跨代累积的改进，仍有待更充分的验证。

**Can****AI****improve AI?**

**现有研究给出了有边界的肯定：AI能在明确条件下帮助改进AI。**

**下一步的挑战，是让每一次可信的改进，都成为下一次进步的起点。**

<https://www.preprints.org/manuscript/202608.2108>

entries.title: 淘宝丰收节新产地报告：小县城，大冠军 186个家乡宝藏改写中国物产版图
entries.content:
原创 阿里研究院 2026-09-11 17:34 浙江

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=188a757a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_jpg%2FLboD4aeh9fbpSTqCZPA0rl0NiaEouEcIuvZtd1Xv48HrpzALn6LZ5PdhJd5Kw0DDHhLxTicx9g4oyjgGk8LeEDAcWdA5ILSV0nUjxRFQMnSF8%2F0%3Fwx_fmt%3Djpeg)

这两年，网友掀起了一场声势浩大的“农业大摸底”。这些“本不该产自这里”的东西，正在一个个走出县城、走向全国。

本文作者：

左臣明  淘天集团研究中心

**导 言**

这两年，网友掀起了一场声势浩大的“农业大摸底”。人们惊讶地发现：新疆阿拉尔，能在盐碱沙漠里种出水稻；离海最远的新疆尼勒克，能养出冷水三文鱼；江西上犹一个内陆县，能做出鲜炖即食燕窝；云南永德，甚至长成了全球最大的夏威夷果产区。这些“本不该产自这里”的东西，正在一个个走出县城、走向全国。猎奇之余，人们开始意识到：中国的物产版图，正在被悄悄改写。

淘宝的数据把这场改写看得很清楚。过去一年，淘宝共涌现出186个农产品“新产地”，覆盖26个省份、154个县、128个品类，其中51个县直接拿下所在类目的全国第一。江西共青城的天然粉粉食品年成交额超亿元，一县撑起一个新品类；山西万荣的西梅从0起步、拿下全国第一；山东海阳一个县同时拿下鳕鱼、淡水鱼、青花鱼三个冠军……

这份名单的深处，藏着五种不同的“新”：涌现之新，让沉默的县被看见；升级之新，让县域从卖原料到造商品；替代之新，让高端货架坐上中国县城；心智之新，让传统品类装上年轻人的心智；流通之新，让农产品版图从少数枢纽走向万县开花。

如果说前几年的“农业大摸底”还带着几分猎奇，那么今天再看这些新产地，猎奇已经长成产业。每一个反常识产地的背后，都是一条规模化、标准化、数字化的成长路径，也是一份可以被复制的乡村振兴样本。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=1c2a277e&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FLboD4aeh9fawMwPQGJUe93tibn1rCtRxsezE3rCWvAxTnNBzZib39mQfHmu7DG1oZ7uLS3ROPpC70k9AAos9uoia6YDYD7dkw9I0UqLRrHfreU%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

**01 一年涌现186个新产地，51个县拿下全国第一**

淘宝新产地，指的是过去一年（2025年8月1日至2026年7月31日），在淘宝天猫平台上，成交额达到一定规模且成长性高、年成交额是2021年10倍以上的县域农产品品类。

过去一年，淘宝共涌现出186个新产地，覆盖26个省份、154个县、128个品类。看增长曲线，4年前，47个新产地从0起步，如今已是品类主力，有61个新产地成交额是2021年100倍以上，两项合计近六成新产地完成了从“沉默”到“爆发”的跃迁。

看竞争位次，103个新产地已跻身全国类目前三，其中51个直接拿下全国第一。县域农产品电商的竞争，正在从“有没有”进入“排第几”。

**表1  淘宝新产地成交额TOP10**

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=d7f43767&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FLboD4aeh9fY97HfNHoBJKWzFFEPHM7Xicico3n5TiagwVOLOcYf8ichhj75TXeSFcVmniaysEcWiay9NGqxicK6pH8br0VYd2LGn60icHXuodWKDpsI%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=819eb027&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FLboD4aeh9fZmrXjiafuXFMNRpog5qH3QsicMQ8WCTU8s1HUro9ddTiaM3Vpt7ZNcbZBd4S8ZAKROk1EhtQrjMIFIoXrrR7kuqe4826fjOCicq5Y%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

**02 山东、福建、云南、河南领跑，五强省份各有绝活**

从省份看，山东以25个新产地居首，福建17个，云南、河南各15个，湖南、安徽各13个，前五强合计98个，占52.7%。但真正拉开差距的不是数量，是每个省版图里的“绝活”。

山东是冠军最多的省份，8个全国第一，海阳一个县同时拿下鳕鱼、淡水鱼、青花鱼三个冠军，海鲜和山货双线阵容，山东是最完整的一个。

福建的特点是有6个新产地从0起步，数量居全国首位，山海茶经济并重。

来自西部省份的云南表现突出，产地数量与河南并列第三，有5个新产地位居所在类目全国前三，其中蒙自蓝莓位居全国第一。

中部省份河南和湖南主打“粮仓菜篮子”的线上化，河南手握沁阳玉米须茶、睢县干货粉条、方城新鲜花生3个全国第一；湖南吉首市一县独占土豆、新鲜玉米、南瓜3个全国第一；安徽则以特色油种、奇亚籽、乳鸽三冠军展现出“小而美”品类的供给能力。

让“产地”本身成为消费者愿意付出溢价的“品牌”，这是中国农产品消费正在发生的最深刻变化。

消费者的选择在说话。在淘宝上，搜索关键词已悄然从泛泛的“草莓”“蓝莓”聚焦到“丹东草莓”“蒙自蓝莓”，地名不再只是地理标注，而是品质的承诺和信任的载体。

如果说，农产品电商的第一阶段是“上行”，解决“卖不卖得出”，下一阶段则是“产地优选”，回答“卖得好、卖得久、能不能成品牌”。消费者从认品类转向认产地，产业带从卖原料转向造商品，供给版图从少数枢纽走向多点开花，这三种变化正在县域共振，“新产地”就是这场变化的名单。

在淘宝，这些原产地优质农产品不仅能获得“产地优选”标识，还能得到平台流量、营销等资源倾斜，让更多源头好货被高效识别和推荐。

淘宝新产地的本质，是用数字化基础设施为中国农产品品牌化提供从“被发现”到“被信赖”的全链路支撑。186个新产地不是自然涌现，是政府、平台、协会、商家形成合力，持续投向县域的结果：以成长性数据识别“隐形产区”，让沉默的县被看见；以消费趋势反哺产品设计，把即饮阿胶、配方羊奶粉、鲜炖燕窝等新形态送回县域；以冷链和产地—消费地匹配织密分布式供给，让一个县不必做全国主产区，也能稳定服务区域市场，培育电商生态。

小县城，大冠军。这份从“农业大摸底”长出来的产业地图，才刚刚展开。当每一个县域都能把自己的天赋变成产品、把产品变成品牌，中国农产品电商将完成从“产品上行”到“品牌崛起”的关键一跃。而这张不断生长的新产地版图，正是乡村振兴最生动的注脚。

**数据说明**

本报告数据来源覆盖淘宝天猫全平台。“新产地”以电商销售所在县为统计口径，反映产品的电商销售规模与增长。多数为农产品生产地，少数为农产品加工、包装或集散地。是否属于原产地，以国家地理标志、农业农村部品牌名录等官方认定为准。

entries.title: Ternus and Joswiak talk about designing the iPhone Duo in secret
entries.content:
In a new interview, Apple CEO [John Ternus](https://appleinsider.com/inside/john-ternus "John Ternus") talks about the long road to the iPhone Duo, while Joz is delighted just how secret they kept the project.  
  

![Two men seated outdoors, one in a dark t-shirt listening attentively while the other in glasses and a patterned shirt speaks with a hand gesture, against a bright, leafy background](https://media.appleinsider.com/gallery/68948-145304-000-lead-Ternus-and-Joz-xl.jpg)  
John Ternus (left) and Greg Joswiak - image credit: Tom's Guide/TechRadar

  
It had been rumored for such a long time, and so many leaks got little details right, but overall the iPhone Duo has been Apple's best-kept secret in years. Talking to *Tom's Guide* and *TechRadar* in a [new interview](https://www.tomsguide.com/phones/iphones/interview-apple-ceo-john-ternus-on-his-defining-moment-for-the-iphone-duo), [Greg Joswiak](https://appleinsider.com/inside/greg-joswiak "Greg Joswiak"), senior vice president of worldwide marketing, says he's "super proud" of that.  
  
"We put extra security on it, we didn't talk about it to anyone," he said. "We had a very funny codename, which I won't even repeat, that had nothing to do with it."  
  
  
 [Continue Reading on AppleInsider](https://appleinsider.com/articles/26/09/11/ternus-and-joswiak-talk-about-designing-the-iphone-duo-in-secret?utm_source=rss) | [Discuss on our Forums](https://forums.appleinsider.com/discussion/245628?urm_source=rss)

entries.title: Why Apple’s new audio AI features aren’t the privacy nightmare you think they are
entries.content:
[Macworld](https://www.macworld.com)

With the [Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4](https://www.macworld.com/article/3231085/apple-watch-series-12-and-ultra-4-delivered-7-actual-surprises.html), Apple is introducing some neat new audio-based AI features that seem genuinely useful and exciting.

The new S11 processor includes hardware that makes it possible to continually listen and (lightly) process audio without ruining battery life, and Apple is using that to provide four new AI-powered features. It calls these features “Audio Intelligence” because Apple can’t help but brand everything.

* **Full-time Shazam:** The watch can detect music playing and automatically identify it using Shazam, displaying it on widget in the Smart Stack. Apple Watches already do this on demand, but the new thing here is that it does it continuously in the background [like Pixel phones](https://support.google.com/pixelphone/answer/7535326?hl=en).
* **Sound recognition:** The same feature you can get on HomePods and iPhone now comes to Apple Watch. You can get notified visually when your watch hears sounds such as doorbells, fire alarms, sirens, etc. You used to need your iPhone nearby to use this feature, but the Series 12 and Ultra 4 can do it independently.
* **Live Rewind:** Double-tap the digital crown to see a text readout of the last 15 seconds of what was said around you. You can then ask Siri about it or save it to the Siri app.
* **Siri Recap:** Get a high-level summary of an entire conversation in the Siri app, so you don’t forget specifics or need to take notes.

The first two of those features don’t really bother anyone. Those are existing features, and the only new thing is that the Apple Watch can do them in the background without iPhone intervention. The last two will be available later this year as a beta, and those are the ones that have people freaking out. Are people’s Apple Watches going to be recording you all the time?

Apple has issued a [Audio Intelligence Security Overview](https://apple.sjv.io/c/321564/435031/7613?subid1=rss&u=https://www.apple.com/privacy/docs/Audio_Intelligence_Privacy_Overview_Sep_2026.pdf) white paper to help users understand how all this works and how it protects everyone’s privacy. It’s worth a read, but here are the highlights.

## How Live Rewind works

On the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, audio from the microphone is continuously flowing into a little buffer in the Secure Enclave. This actually happens on *lots* of Apple products; it’s how they know if you’ve said “Hey Siri” or not. This is a rolling buffer, where new data continuously replaces old data.

The Secure Enclave is a completely separate hardware block that is not accessible to the rest of the operating system, or any apps, or even Apple. It’s where your Face ID and Touch ID data is stored, for example.

![apple watch siri live rewind](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/apple-watch-siri-live-rewind.jpg?quality=50&strip=all&w=1200)

Live Rewind will show you what you missed—privately.

Apple

When you double-press the Digital Crown, the last 15 seconds of that buffer is sent via an encrypted secure transfer to your iPhone, where an AI model transcribes it. This happens in the iPhone’s Secure Enclave, so the audio cannot be accessed by the rest of iOS, or any app, or the user, or even Apple. This is just a straight voice-to-text transcription; it doesn’t identify or label people who are speaking. The audio is then immediately discarded.

The text of the translation is then sent back to Apple Watch where it appears on the display. It is not saved unless you ask Siri about it or save it to the Siri app to revisit later. The Siri app’s data is end-to-end encrypted and synced between devices, and users can control whether conversations are automatically deleted after 30 days, 1 year, or saved forever. Apple cannot decrypt this data, even with a court order—only the user has the key.

And one more thing, an [audible chime plays](https://support.apple.com/en-us/148354) from the speaker on your Apple Watch when you implement Live Rewind, even if your Apple Watch is on silent or you have headphones connected.

So that’s how Live Rewind protects your privacy and those around you. Raw audio data can’t ever be accessed by the user, the system, Apple, or any apps. It’s just straight translated to text, which is then optionally saved in the end-to-end encrypted Siri app.

## How Siri Recap works

Siri Recap works in a similar way, but there’s more going on. You’ll be able to leave it on all the time, only when you trigger it manually, or specify certain places or times when it can’t operate.

First, a tiny little lightweight model simply detects if a conversation is happening at all.

If it is, that encrypted and secure audio buffer is sent to the iPhone (via an encrypted data transfer) for processing. It is transcribed to condensed text, and the raw audio is then immediately discarded. It is never accessible to the OS, apps, the user, or Apple.

This transcribed text passes through a safety filter than will remove potentially harmful terms. Then it is encrypted and sent to Apple’s Private Cloud Compute servers to be summarized, along with relevent contextual data that can make the summary better (such as what music you might be listening to, a relevant calendar entry, or high-level place information like what city you’re in).

![Siri recap](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/siri-recap-settings.jpg?quality=50&strip=all&w=1200)

Apple

Private Cloud Compute generates a title and summary with key points. It removes any specific identifiable or sensitive info such as place names or financial data, while leaving generic places names like “park” or “grocery store.” That summary is then sent back to your devices, encrypted, where it is stored in the Siri app in a new Recaps tab. All data on Apple’s Private Cloud Compute servers is always discarded immediately after processing; Apple never saves any of it.

The summaries in the Recaps tab are deleted automatically after seven days unless you choose to save it.

Like Live Rewind, Siri Recap does not create a recording, does not identify speakers, and does not even create a verbatim transcript. No audio is ever accessible at any step of the process by the user, any app, or Apple.

Finally, Live Rewind and Siri Recap are not available for users under the age of 13. For users under 18 on a Child Account, access to Live Rewind and Siri Recap must be turned on by a parent or guardian.

entries.title: Best iPhone 2026: Every iPhone compared
entries.content:
[Macworld](https://www.macworld.com)

Apple’s 2026 iPhone lineup is broader than ever, ranging from the relatively affordable iPhone 17e to the high-end [iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max](https://www.macworld.com/article/2953687/iphone-18-pro-max-2026-release-date-design-specs-price.html), plus the ultra-thin iPhone Air and the new folding [iPhone Duo](https://www.macworld.com/article/2629813/iphone-ultra-folding-design-price-specs-release-date.html). That gives buyers more choice, but it also makes picking the right model more complicated than simply choosing the newest or most expensive iPhone.

For most people, the iPhone 17 is the best all-round choice, thanks to its 6.3-inch ProMotion display, strong battery life, dual 48MP cameras and 256GB of storage as standard. The iPhone 17e is the better option if price matters most, while the iPhone 18 Pro is the model to choose for the best cameras and performance. The iPhone 18 Pro Max adds the longest battery life, the iPhone Air prioritises thinness and low weight, and the iPhone Duo offers Apple’s biggest and most flexible display.

Which iPhone is best for you will therefore depend on what you value most. Camera enthusiasts should look closely at the Pro models, heavy users may prefer the Pro Max for its battery life, while parents, older users and anyone trying to keep costs down may find the 17e a much better fit. There can also be excellent value in buying a discounted or refurbished older iPhone rather than paying full price for the latest hardware.

This guide focuses on the best iPhone to buy for different types of user and budget. If you want to dig deeper into the differences between every model, see our complete [iPhone Buying Guide](https://www.macworld.com/article/670458/iphone-buying-guide.html), where we compare the cameras, displays, performance, storage, battery life and other key specifications across Apple’s current lineup.

## Which iPhone to buy: At a glance

| If you want… | Then buy… |
| --- | --- |
| Best camera | iPhone 18 Pro |
| Best battery | iPhone 18 Pro Max |
| Biggest screen | iPhone Duo |
| Best all-rounder | iPhone 17 |
| Best value | iPhone 17e |
| Lightest | iPhone Air |
| Cheapest | Refurbished iPhone (iPhone 16 or newer) |

## 1. Apple iPhone 17 – Best iPhone for most people

![Apple iPhone 17 - Best iPhone for most people](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/iphone_17_lavender_3.jpg?quality=50&strip=all)

### Pros

* Excellent overall value
* ProMotion Always-On display
* Dual 48MP cameras

### Cons

* No dedicated telephoto
* Limited to 512GB

Best Prices Today:

![amazon](https://www.macworld.com/wp-content/themes/idg-b2b-base-theme/dist/static/img/amazon-logo.svg)

[Check](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Apple+iPhone+17&tag=macworld05-20&asc_refurl=https://www.macworld.com)

Price comparison from over 24,000 stores worldwide

### Why we recommend it

The iPhone 17 brings several features previously reserved for Pro models to Apple’s mainstream iPhone, including a 120Hz ProMotion display and Always-On support. It also offers the fast A19 chip, dual 48MP cameras, an improved Centre Stage selfie camera, strong battery life and 256GB of storage as standard. For most buyers, it strikes the best balance between price and features.

### Buy iPhone 17 if

Buy the iPhone 17 if you want the best all-round iPhone without paying Pro prices. Its 6.3-inch ProMotion display, excellent cameras, strong battery life and 256GB starting storage make it particularly appealing to anyone upgrading from an iPhone 14 or older.

### Don’t buy iPhone 17 if

Don’t buy it if you want optical zoom beyond 2x or Apple’s most advanced camera features—in that case, choose the iPhone 18 Pro. The iPhone Air is a better choice if thinness and low weight are your priorities, while existing iPhone 16 owners may find the upgrade relatively modest unless ProMotion and improved battery life are particularly important.

### What do you get that you don’t get with the iPhone 17e?

For the extra $200, the iPhone 17 gives you a larger 6.3-inch ProMotion Always-On display, Dynamic Island, a second 48MP Ultra Wide camera with macro photography, a brighter screen, stronger graphics performance, a better 18MP Centre Stage selfie camera and longer battery life. For most people who can afford the difference, it’s money well spent.

### What do you get that you don’t get with the iPhone 16?

For $100 more, you get double the base storage at 256GB, a larger 6.3-inch ProMotion Always-On display, an upgraded 48MP Ultra Wide camera, an improved 18MP Centre Stage selfie camera, longer battery life, faster charging and the newer A19 processor. At full price, the iPhone 17 is the better buy.

### Key specs

The iPhone 17 combines a 6.3-inch ProMotion display, Always-On support and the A19 chip with dual 48MP rear cameras and 256GB of storage as standard. It offers many of the features most people actually want from a Pro iPhone without the Pro price.

* **Starts at**: $799 / £799 (256GB)
* **Display**: 6.3-inch OLED ProMotion (120Hz)
* **Chip**: A19
* **Storage**: 256GB–512GB
* **Cameras**: 48MP Main + 48MP Ultra Wide, 18MP front camera
* **Battery**: Up to 30 hours of video playback

### Should you buy or wait?

Buy now. The iPhone 17 offers excellent value, while the iPhone 18 isn’t expected until spring 2027 and may bring higher prices rather than transformative upgrades. Waiting for Prime Day or Black Friday could make sense if you’re looking for a discount.

Read our full
[Apple iPhone 17 review](https://www.macworld.com/article/2925527/iphone-17-review.html)

## 2. Apple iPhone 18 Pro – Best for photography

![Apple iPhone 18 Pro - Best for photography](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/uo.jpg?quality=50&strip=all)

### Pros

* Excellent triple-camera system
* Powerful A20 Pro chip
* Strong battery life

### Cons

* Expensive starting price
* Overkill for most buyers

Best Prices Today:

![amazon](https://www.macworld.com/wp-content/themes/idg-b2b-base-theme/dist/static/img/amazon-logo.svg)

[Check](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Apple+iPhone+18+Pro&tag=macworld05-20&asc_refurl=https://www.macworld.com)

Price comparison from over 24,000 stores worldwide

### Why we recommend it

The iPhone 18 Pro is the model to buy if you want Apple’s best cameras and performance without stepping up to the much larger Pro Max or experimental folding iPhone Duo. Its variable-aperture camera is a meaningful upgrade for photographers, while the A20 Pro chip, improved cooling, longer battery life and faster charging make it particularly capable for gaming, video and demanding AI workloads. Crucially, it gets the same cameras and processor as the Pro Max, making it the better-value Pro model for most buyers.

### Buy iPhone 18 Pro if

Buy the iPhone 18 Pro if you want Apple’s best camera system; need more performance than the standard iPhone offers; regularly play demanding games or use intensive creative or AI apps; or want excellent battery life without carrying the enormous Pro Max. It’s a compelling upgrade for anyone with an iPhone 15 Pro or older.

### Don’t buy iPhone 18 Pro if

Most people don’t need the iPhone 18 Pro. The standard iPhone 17 already offers an excellent 6.3-inch 120Hz ProMotion display, A19 chip, dual 48MP cameras, 256GB of storage and strong battery life for considerably less. And if your main priority is screen size and endurance, the Pro Max is the better choice.

### What do you get that you don’t get with the iPhone 17?

The biggest advantage is the camera system. The iPhone 18 Pro adds a 48MP Telephoto camera with 4x and 8x optical-quality zoom, plus a variable-aperture 48MP Main camera for improved low-light shooting and greater creative control. You also get the faster A20 Pro chip with a seven-core GPU and improved vapor-chamber cooling for better sustained performance during gaming, video editing and AI tasks.

### Key specs

The iPhone 18 Pro combines Apple’s new 2nm A20 Pro processor with a sophisticated triple-48MP camera system, including a variable-aperture Main camera and 4x/8x Telephoto. It retains a manageable 6.3-inch ProMotion display while improving sustained performance, battery life and charging speeds.

* **Starts at**: $1,199 / £1,199 (256GB)
* **Display**: 6.3-inch OLED ProMotion (120Hz)
* **Chip**: A20 Pro, 6-core CPU, 7-core GPU
* **Storage**: 256GB–2TB
* **Cameras**: 48MP variable-aperture Main + 48MP Ultra Wide + 48MP Telephoto (4x/8x), 18MP front camera
* **Battery**: Up to 36 hours of video playback

## Should you buy or wait?

The iPhone 18 Pro goes on sale September 18, with pre-orders starting September 12, so there’s little reason to wait if you want one immediately. Bargain hunters may prefer to hold off until Amazon’s Prime Day sale or Black Friday on November 27, when retailers and mobile networks may offer trade-in bonuses, contract incentives or modest discounts. Large outright savings are unlikely so soon after launch.

## 3. Apple 18 iPhone Pro Max – Best for battery life

![Apple 18 iPhone Pro Max - Best for battery life](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/iPhone-18-Pro-Cameras.jpeg?quality=50&strip=all)

### Pros

* Outstanding battery life
* Huge 6.9-inch display
* Excellent Pro cameras

### Cons

* Very large and heavy
* Expensive starting price

Best Prices Today: 

Retailer

Price

![amazon](https://www.macworld.com/wp-content/themes/idg-b2b-base-theme/dist/static/img/amazon-logo.svg)

[Check](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Apple+iPhone+18+Pro+Max&tag=macworld05-20&asc_refurl=https://www.macworld.com)

Price comparison from over 24,000 stores worldwide

### Why we recommend it

The iPhone 18 Pro Max is Apple’s ultimate conventional iPhone, combining a huge 6.9-inch ProMotion display with the powerful A20 Pro chip, Apple’s best camera system and the longest battery life in the range. Its biggest advantage over the regular Pro is endurance, with Apple rating it for up to 45 hours of video playback.

### Buy the iPhone 18 Pro Max if

Buy the iPhone 18 Pro Max if you want the biggest possible display and longest battery life, regularly use your phone for photography, video, gaming or other demanding tasks, and don’t mind carrying a large and relatively heavy device. It’s particularly well suited to frequent travellers and heavy users who want to minimise charging.

### Don’t buy iPhone 18 Pro Max if

Don’t buy it if you prefer a smaller, lighter phone or simply want the Pro cameras and performance. The iPhone 18 Pro offers essentially the same A20 Pro chip, camera system and Pro features in a more manageable 6.3-inch design for $100/£100 less. At 249g, the Pro Max is also particularly heavy.

### What do you get that you don’t get with the iPhone 18 Pro?

Not much in terms of features. Both models have the same A20 Pro processor, triple-48MP camera system, variable-aperture Main camera and storage options up to 2TB. The Pro Max instead gives you a larger 6.9-inch display rather than 6.3 inches and substantially better battery life: up to 45 hours of video playback versus 36 hours on the iPhone 18 Pro. You pay an extra $100/£100 for those advantages.

### Key specs

The iPhone 18 Pro Max combines Apple’s huge 6.9-inch ProMotion display with the new 2nm A20 Pro chip, three 48MP rear cameras and a variable-aperture Main camera. Its defining advantage is battery life, reaching up to 45 hours of video playback.

* **Starts at**: $1,299 / £1,299 (256GB)
* **Display**: 6.9-inch Super Retina XDR OLED ProMotion (120Hz)
* **Chip**: A20 Pro, 6-core CPU, 7-core GPU
* **Storage**: 256GB–2TB
* **Cameras**: 48MP variable-aperture Main + 48MP Ultra Wide + 48MP Telephoto, 18MP front camera
* **Battery**: Up to 45 hours of video playback

### Should you buy or wait?

The iPhone 18 Pro Max goes on sale September 18, with pre-orders starting September 12. Buy at launch if you want it immediately, but bargain hunters may prefer to wait for Amazon’s Prime Day sales or Black Friday on November 27. Major outright discounts are unlikely so soon after launch, although trade-in offers and contract incentives could be worthwhile.

## 4. Apple iPhone Duo – Best foldable iPhone

![Apple iPhone Duo - Best foldable iPhone ](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/iPhone-Duo-Colors.jpeg?quality=50&strip=all)

### Pros

* Innovative folding displayExcellent multitasking potentialStrong A20 Pro performance

### Cons

* Extremely expensive
* Weaker camera versatility

Best Prices Today: 

Retailer

Price

![amazon](https://www.macworld.com/wp-content/themes/idg-b2b-base-theme/dist/static/img/amazon-logo.svg)

[Check](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Apple+iPhone+Duo&tag=macworld05-20&asc_refurl=https://www.macworld.com)

Price comparison from over 24,000 stores worldwide

### Why we recommend it

The iPhone Duo offers something no other iPhone can: a compact phone that unfolds into a 7.6-inch tablet-like device. The larger display gives you considerably more room for multitasking, watching video, reading, gaming and creative work, while the outer screen keeps it usable as a conventional phone when closed. Add the A20 Pro chip and clever dual-screen features and it’s easily Apple’s most innovative iPhone.

### Buy iPhone Duo if

Buy the iPhone Duo if you want the versatility of an iPhone and small tablet in one device, regularly multitask between apps, consume lots of content on your phone, or simply want Apple’s most distinctive new hardware. It’s particularly compelling if you value screen space and flexibility more than having Apple’s absolute best camera system.

### Don’t buy iPhone Duo if

Don’t buy the Duo if value, photography or portability are your priorities. At $1,999/£1,999 it costs $800/£800 more than the iPhone 18 Pro, while lacking Face ID, a dedicated telephoto camera, variable aperture, ProRes and the Action button. At 254g it is also the heaviest iPhone in the range. For most buyers, the iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max will be a better all-round purchase.

### What do you get that you don’t get with the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max?

The Duo’s defining advantage is its 7.6-inch folding display, which offers around 50 percent more screen area than the iPhone 18 Pro Max and supports Split View multitasking, while the 5.4-inch outer screen keeps it usable like a compact iPhone when closed. You also get fold-specific features such as Duo Preview, Smart Take, Kid Cue, hands-free video positioning and an under-display inner camera, with Apple Pencil USB-C support coming later in 2026. The trade-off is photography: the Duo has only two 48MP rear cameras, with no dedicated telephoto, variable aperture, ProRes or Apple Log.

### Key specs

The iPhone Duo transforms from a compact 5.4-inch phone into a 7.6-inch folding device, providing substantially more room for apps, video and multitasking. It combines two 120Hz ProMotion OLED displays with the A20 Pro chip, dual 48MP cameras, strong battery life and storage up to 2TB.

* **Starts at**: $1,999 / £1,999 (256GB)
* **Displays**: 5.4-inch outer + 7.6-inch folding OLED, ProMotion (120Hz)
* **Chip**: A20 Pro
* **Storage**: 256GB–2TB
* **Cameras**: 48MP Main + 48MP Ultra Wide, 12MP outer front camera + under-display inner camera
* **Battery**: Up to 44 hours of video playback on outer display; 31 hours on inner display
* **Authentication**: Touch ID
* **Weight**: 254g

### Should you buy or wait?

The iPhone Duo goes on sale October 23, with pre-orders opening October 16. Buy at launch if you want Apple’s first foldable as soon as possible. If price matters more than being first, waiting until Black Friday on November 27 could bring carrier incentives or trade-in deals, although significant outright discounts on such a new and specialised device are unlikely.

## 5. Apple iPhone 17e – Best budget iPhone

![Apple iPhone 17e - Best budget iPhone ](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/c5_c16982.webp)

### Pros

* Excellent budget value
* Strong A19 performance
* 256GB base storage

### Cons

* No ProMotion display
* No Ultra Wide camera

[Check](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Apple+iPhone+17e&tag=macworld05-20&asc_refurl=https://www.macworld.com)

Price comparison from over 24,000 stores worldwide

### Why we recommend it

The iPhone 17e is Apple’s most affordable current iPhone, offering modern performance and Apple Intelligence without flagship pricing. It combines the A19 chip with useful upgrades including MagSafe and 256GB of base storage. If you don’t need multiple cameras or a high-refresh-rate display, it delivers the essentials at an attractive price.

### Buy the iPhone 17e if

Buy the iPhone 17e if you want a modern iPhone with strong performance and years of software support for as little as possible. It’s particularly appealing to anyone upgrading from an iPhone 12 or 13, switching from Android or buying their first iPhone.

### Don’t buy iPhone 17e if

Don’t buy it if you want ProMotion, an Always-On display, Dynamic Island or a versatile camera system. If your budget stretches another $200/£200, the iPhone 17 is a substantially more complete phone.

### What do you get that you don’t get with the iPhone 16?

The iPhone 17e gives you the newer A19 chip, longer battery life, 256GB of storage as standard, Apple’s newer C1X modem and Ceramic Shield 2 protection. Its biggest advantage, however, is value: at similar real-world prices, it is generally the smarter long-term purchase.

### What don’t you get that you get with the iPhone 17?

The iPhone 17 gives you a larger and significantly more advanced 6.3-inch 120Hz ProMotion display with Dynamic Island and Always-On support, plus a second 48MP Ultra Wide camera. You also get a better 18MP Centre Stage selfie camera, stronger graphics performance and longer battery life. The 17e covers the essentials extremely well, but the iPhone 17 feels much more complete.

### Key specs

The iPhone 17e pairs the A19 chip with a 6.1-inch OLED display, 256GB of storage as standard and up to 26 hours of battery life, while omitting premium features such as Dynamic Island, ProMotion and an Ultra Wide camera.

* **Cameras**: 48MP Fusion Main with 2x optical-quality zoom + 12MP TrueDepth front camera
* **Battery**: Up to 26 hours of video playback

### Should you buy or wait?

Buy now. The iPhone 17e offers excellent value and isn’t expected to be replaced until early 2027. Discounts could make it even more attractive, but there’s little reason to delay purely for the next generation.

## Which iPhone has the best camera? iPhone 18 Pro

![iPhone 18 Pro camera](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/iphone-18-Pro-camera.jpg?quality=50&strip=all&w=1200)

Apple

The **iPhone 18 Pro** and **iPhone 18 Pro Max** have the best camera systems of any current iPhone. Both models use the same triple-48MP rear camera setup, so there is no photographic advantage to choosing the larger Pro Max unless you also want its bigger display and longer battery life.

The headline upgrade is the 48MP Main camera with variable aperture, which gives photographers more control over depth of field and should improve low-light performance. The Pro models also include a 48MP Ultra Wide camera and a 48MP Telephoto camera with 4x and 8x optical-quality zoom, giving them far more flexibility than Apple’s cheaper iPhones.

The standard **iPhone 17** is still an excellent camera phone, with 48MP Main and Ultra Wide cameras, plus an improved 18MP Centre Stage front camera. For everyday photography it will be more than enough for most people, but it lacks the dedicated telephoto lens, longer zoom and advanced video features of the Pro models.

The **iPhone Duo** is more compromised. Despite its premium price, it has only two 48MP rear cameras and lacks a dedicated telephoto camera, variable aperture, ProRes and Apple Log. Its strengths are instead its fold-specific shooting features and dual-screen flexibility.

The **iPhone Air** and **iPhone 17e** are the least versatile, with just a single 48MP rear camera.

**Our choice**: If photography and video are your priority, buy the **iPhone 18 Pro**. It offers the same camera system as the Pro Max for less money and in a more manageable size.

## Which iPhone has the best battery life? iPhone 18 Pro Max

![iPhone 18 Pro Max size comparison](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/iPhoen-18-Pro-Max-size-comparison.jpg?quality=50&strip=all&w=1200)

Bigger iPhone means bigger battery.

Apple

The **iPhone 18 Pro Max** has the best battery life of any current iPhone, with Apple rating it for up to 45 hours of video playback. That puts it comfortably ahead of the smaller **iPhone 18 Pro** and makes battery life one of the strongest reasons to choose the Pro Max.

The **iPhone Duo** comes surprisingly close, with up to 44 hours of video playback when using its outer 5.4-inch display. However, battery life drops to around 31 hours when using the larger 7.6-inch folding display, so the Pro Max remains the better choice if endurance is your priority.

The **iPhone 18 Pro** is also excellent, offering up to 36 hours of video playback. That makes it a good compromise if you want strong battery life without carrying the much larger and heavier Pro Max.

Further down the range, the **iPhone 17** offers up to 30 hours, making it the best mainstream option for battery life. The iPhone Air manages around 27 hours despite its exceptionally thin design, while the **iPhone 17e** reaches 26 hours.

The older **iPhone 16** trails the current lineup at up to 22 hours of video playback.

**Our choice**: If battery life matters above everything else, the **iPhone 18 Pro Max** is the clear winner. Its combination of a 45-hour rating, huge 6.9-inch display and Pro-level performance makes it particularly well suited to heavy users, travellers and anyone who wants to get through a long day without worrying about charging.

Here’s how the current iPhone lineup compares in terms of battery life

| Model | Video Playback (Apple’s rating) | Geekbench 4 Test (minutes) | Wired Charging (50% time) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| iPhone 18 Pro Max | Up to 43 hours | TBC | ~15 min (60W+) |
| iPhone Duo | Up to 44 hours outer / 31 hours inner | TBC | ~20 min (60W+) |
| iPhone 18 Pro | Up to 34 hours | TBC | ~15 min (60W+) |
| iPhone 17 | Up to 30 hours | 1,053 | ~20 min (40W) |
| iPhone Air | Up to 27 hours | 880 | ~30 min (20W) |
| iPhone 17e | Up to 26 hours | 854 | ~30 min (20W) |
| iPhone 16 | Up to 24 hours | 867 | ~30 min (20W) |

## What is the best value iPhone? iPhone 17

![I switched to the iPhone 17](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/I-switched-to-the-iPhone-17.jpg?quality=50&strip=all&w=1200)

Hannah Cowton-Barnes / Foundry

The **iPhone 17** offers the best overall value for money in Apple’s current lineup. The **iPhone 17e** is cheaper, but the extra $200/£200 for the iPhone 17 buys a surprisingly large number of worthwhile upgrades.

You get a larger 6.3-inch 120Hz ProMotion display with Always-On support and Dynamic Island, rather than the 17e’s standard 60Hz 6.1-inch screen. The iPhone 17 also adds a second 48MP Ultra Wide camera, including macro photography, along with a better 18MP Centre Stage front camera.

Battery life is stronger too, at up to 30 hours of video playback, compared with 26 hours on the iPhone 17e. You also get stronger graphics performance and a more premium overall experience, while both phones start with a generous 256GB of storage.

At $799/£799, the iPhone 17 also compares very favourably with the older iPhone 16. For just $100/£100 more, you get double the base storage, ProMotion, a larger and brighter display, improved cameras, the newer A19 chip and significantly better battery life.

If your priority is spending as little as possible, choose the iPhone 17e which delivers excellent performance for $599/£599. Or seek out a **refurbished iPhone** from the [Apple Refurbished Store](https://apple.sjv.io/c/321564/435031/7613?subid1=rss&u=https://www.apple.com/shop/refurbished/iphone) or another [place that sells refurbished iPhones](https://www.macworld.com/article/670952/how-to-buy-second-hand-refurbished-iphone.html).

**Our choice**: In terms of the features and hardware you get for every pound or dollar spent, the **iPhone 17** is the sweet spot. For most buyers, it delivers the best balance of price, performance, cameras, display quality, battery life and longevity without paying for Pro-level features they may never use. Even better if you can find a [iPhone 17 deal](https://www.macworld.com/article/672801/best-iphone-deals.html), then you are really getting a bargain.

## Best iPhone for gaming: iPhone 18 Pro

![iPhone 17 Pro Max games](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Apple-Games-on-iPhone-17-Pro-Max.jpg?quality=50&strip=all&w=1200)

Foundry

The **iPhone 18 Pro** is the best iPhone for gaming for most people, thanks to its combination of the A20 Pro chip, seven-core GPU and improved vapor-chamber cooling.

The A20 Pro is Apple’s fastest iPhone processor, but the cooling system is just as important for gaming. Better heat management should help the iPhone 18 Pro maintain high performance for longer during demanding games, rather than slowing down as the phone gets hot. Its 6.3-inch 120Hz ProMotion display also provides smooth animation and responsive gameplay without making the phone excessively large or heavy.

The **iPhone 18 Pro Max** offers essentially the same gaming performance, but adds a much larger 6.9-inch display and significantly longer battery life. That arguably makes it the best choice for serious mobile gamers who value screen size and endurance, although it is heavier and costs more.

The **iPhone Duo** also uses the A20 Pro and has an enormous 7.6-inch folding display, which could be fantastic for some games, but its weight, price and unconventional form factor make it a more specialised choice.

**Our choice**: For most gamers, the iPhone 18 Pro offers the best balance of performance, cooling, display quality and portability. It’s the best choice if you prefer a more pocketable device but still want top-tier gaming power.

## Best iPhone for seniors and older users: iPhone 17e

![iPhone 17e screen](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/iPhone-17e-review-screen.jpg?quality=50&strip=all&w=1200)

David Price / Foundry

For most older users, the **iPhone 17e** is probably the best choice, because it combines a relatively simple feature set with modern performance, strong battery life and a lower price than Apple’s flagship models.

Its 6.1-inch OLED display is large enough to make text, icons and controls easy to see without making the phone too bulky, while the A19 chip should keep it feeling fast for years. It also supports Apple Intelligence and starts with 256GB of storage, so there’s plenty of room for photos, apps and videos.

The **iPhone 17** is a better option for someone who would benefit from a larger and more advanced display. Its 6.3-inch ProMotion screen, Always-On support and higher brightness can make scrolling, reading and outdoor use more comfortable. It also offers stronger battery life and better cameras, although it costs more.

We don’t recommend the iPhone Air, Pro Max or Duo for older users. The Air sacrifices battery life and camera flexibility for thinness, while the Pro Max and Duo are much heavier and considerably more expensive.

**Our choice**: **iPhone 17e** is the perfect choice for most older users.

## Best iPhone for kids: iPhone 17e

![Iphone 17e sticker upp ur en jeansficka.](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Iphone17e-fickor.jpg?quality=50&strip=all&w=1200)

Ida Blix

The **iPhone 17e** is the [best iPhone for most children](https://www.macworld.com/article/334296/the-best-iphone-for-kids.html). As Apple’s most affordable current-generation model, it offers the best balance of price, performance and longevity, while being easier to justify than a flagship model if it gets lost or damaged.

It uses the same A19 chip as the iPhone 17, albeit with one fewer GPU core, so it’s easily fast enough for games, social media, schoolwork and Apple Intelligence. Battery life is strong, the 6.1-inch OLED display is a sensible size for smaller hands, and the 48MP camera is more than capable for everyday photos, even though it lacks an Ultra Wide lens.

The **iPhone 17** is the better choice for older teenagers who care more about photography, video or display quality. It adds a 48MP Ultra Wide camera, a better front camera and a larger 6.3-inch ProMotion display, but costs considerably more.

A hand-me-down iPhone is also worth considering. It’s the cheapest option and better for the environment, provided you erase the phone first, create a Child Account through Family Sharing, and configure Screen Time and parental controls before handing it over. Read: [How to set up an iPhone for a child](https://www.macworld.com/article/3020154/set-up-parental-controls-safety-settings-child-ipad-iphone.html).

Whichever iPhone you choose, those controls matter. In [iOS 27](https://www.macworld.com/article/2986799/ios-27-new-iphone-features-release-date-beta-compatiblity-apple-intelligence-siri.html), Apple is expanding Screen Time with new category-based Time Allowances, Ask to Browse, more flexible app schedules and improved contact controls. Communication Safety can also detect and blur sensitive, violent or graphic content.

For very young children, an **iPad** may still be a better first Apple device. By the time they reach 11 or 12 though, an iPhone becomes much more useful for staying in touch.

**Our choice**: **iPhone 17e** for most kids; **iPhone 17** for older teens who want better cameras and display quality.

## Should you buy an older iPhone?

![iPhone 15 und iPhone 16](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/iphone1516.jpg?quality=50&strip=all&w=1200)

Macwelt

Buying an older iPhone can be a great way to save money, but the key is choosing a model that still has plenty of useful life ahead of it. Apple typically provides around [five to seven years of major iOS updates](https://www.macworld.com/article/675021/how-long-does-apple-support-iphones.html), with security updates often continuing for longer, so a relatively recent iPhone can remain perfectly usable for years.

We wouldn’t recommend simply buying the cheapest iPhone you can find. Very old models may technically run recent versions of iOS, but performance, battery condition and access to newer features can become increasingly compromised. We currently recommend avoiding anything older than the **iPhone 15 Pro** because even the iPhone 15 doesn’t support Apple Intelligence. You should definitely avoid models such as the iPhone XS and XR that can no longer run the latest iOS releases.

A [refurbished recent-generation iPhone](https://www.macworld.com/article/670952/how-to-buy-second-hand-refurbished-iphone.html) can offer particularly good value. You may be able to buy a former Pro model with better cameras and displays for less than a new entry-level iPhone. Buying from a reputable refurbisher is important, however: check the warranty, battery condition, returns policy and whether genuine replacement parts have been used. Apple’s own refurbished iPhones include a new battery and outer shell and come with a one-year warranty.

**Our advice**: A discounted or refurbished **iPhone 16** or newer should offer an excellent combination of price, features and longevity.

entries.title: Attackers Exploit Critical Cisco FMC Flaw to deploy Qilin ransomware
entries.content:
## Three threat groups are exploiting two Cisco FMC flaws to steal credentials, gain root access and deploy Qilin ransomware.

Cisco Talos says three separate threat groups are exploiting two recently patched Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) flaws. The main target is [CVE-2026-20079](https://securityaffairs.com/188921/security/cisco-fixes-maximum-severity-secure-fmc-bugs-threatening-firewall-security.html), a critical authentication bypass that lets unauthenticated attackers remotely bypass security controls, run scripts and potentially gain root access. Attackers also exploit [CVE-2026-20316](https://securityaffairs.com/196289/security/u-s-cisa-adds-a-cisco-secure-firewall-management-center-fmc-flaw-to-its-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog.html) to access sensitive data through a low-privilege account. The second flaw can be chained with other FMC vulnerabilities to increase privileges.

Cisco linked the attacks to ransomware operations, including [Qilin](https://securityaffairs.com/tag/qilin), as well as state-sponsored activity.

*“Talos’ analysis illustrates three clusters of post-compromise activity on FMC instances associated with state-sponsored and crimeware threat actors, as described below.” [reads the advisory](https://blog.talosintelligence.com/fmc-ongoing-exploitation/). “The first cluster which we track as UAT-12197, involves the exploitation of CVE-2026-20079, leading to the deployment of web shells, a Java Archive (JAR)-based command executor, and credential exfiltration.”*

Talos identified three attack clusters targeting Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC). The first cluster deploys JSP-based web shells and custom command executors into Tomcat webroot directories to query internal databases and harvest user authentication data and credentials.

*“This cluster of activity involved the successful exploitation of CVE-2026-20079 and the subsequent placement of a malicious web shell in the CSM Tomcat webroot directory.” reads the report. “The web shell is JSP-based and Base64 decodes a parameter labelled “F6C1F0E7”, consisting of the class name to load in the JAVA process:”*

The second cluster, attributed to the advanced persistent threat actor UAT-11823 with tooling overlapping Sandworm, establishes Netcat reverse shells, harvests device configurations, and installs the modular ELF malware “[Cyclops Blink](https://securityaffairs.com/tag/cyclops-blink)” for persistent access, DNS over HTTPS resolution, and packet sniffing.

*“The threat actor obtained initial access to compromised systems by either exploiting CVE-2026-20079 or via static credentials.” Talos states. “After obtaining access, UAT-11823 subsequently updated the “license.tmp” file on disk (using Makeself) with a malicious copy to establish a Netcat-based reverse shell to their own command-and-control (C2) server:”*

The third cluster involves [Qilin ransomware](https://securityaffairs.com/tag/qilin-ransomware) operators (UAT-11988) who use static credentials for initial access, perform extensive domain reconnaissance, deploy SOCKS proxies and reverse-SSH tunnels, and execute AV killers before deploying ransomware.

*“Once extensive reconnaissance was completed, the threat actor attempted to establish persistent network access into the victim organization using a Python SOCKS5 proxy (socks5.py) and a reverse-SSH tunnel from the FMC back to the attacker’s own remote host. The following ports were forwarded: LDPA (389), LDAPS (636), Kerberos (88), SMB (445), NETBIOS (135), and WinRM (5985).” concludes the report. “The threat actor conducted extensive probing of endpoints in the victim’s environment, deployed open-source tooling such as impacket, Invoke-TheHash, and custom-made AV killers — all followed by the deployment of the Qilin ransomware on selected endpoints.”*

Cisco strongly urges customers to immediately apply released hotfixes and update detection rules using the provided Snort SIDs while awaiting upcoming comprehensive security hardening updates.

CISA [added](https://securityaffairs.com/198850/security/u-s-cisa-adds-cisco-google-chromium-v8-fortinet-and-citrix-netscaler-flaws-to-its-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog.html) CVE-2026-20079 to its KEV catalog, requiring U.S. federal agencies to patch it by September 12, 2026. CVE-2026-20316 was [added](https://securityaffairs.com/196289/security/u-s-cisa-adds-a-cisco-secure-firewall-management-center-fmc-flaw-to-its-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog.html) in late July.
